what the field says, if you read it as an outcome
Read as outcomes these are impossible: trial
completion did not fall from 78.5% to 19.4%, and
abandonment did not vanish. Both rows are cohort age.
UNKNOWN needs a passed completion date plus two silent
years, and COMPLETED needs the trial to have finished
— neither is available to a 2026 registration, and
both are available to a 2005 one.
table of trial outcomes that includes that row is
mixing a state with a clock.
ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, fetched 2026-09-22, all 603,730 registered studies. Cohort is the year the record was first posted, which is complete for
every row. UNKNOWN is assigned by the register when a study's completion date has passed and the record has not been updated in over two years; it is
not submitted by the sponsor. Every status is shown as a share of its own registration year, so the four lines do not sum to one — the remaining
statuses are omitted for legibility, not excluded from the denominator.
